scope: Vietnam resident organisations and individuals claiming treaty-country foreign tax credit, with tax compliant with foreign law and applicable treaty. Not a blanket entitlement determination.

direct.description: Taxpayer-confirmed copy of foreign income tax return.
Taxpayer-confirmed copy of foreign tax payment document.
Original confirmation from foreign tax authority of tax paid.

tax_sparing.description: Taxpayer-confirmed copy of foreign income tax return.
Taxpayer-confirmed business registration or legal evidence of foreign business activity.
Foreign competent-authority letter confirming exempted/reduced tax and consistency of claimed sparing with treaty and foreign law.

indirect.description: Legal evidence of relationship and capital contribution percentage.
Taxpayer-confirmed foreign income tax return of dividend-distributing company.
Foreign tax authority confirmation of dividend tax and corporate tax paid before dividend distribution.

review_outcome: Tax authority examines application;10 working days from complete dossier excludes supplementation/explanation time under62(3)(b). Dossier completeness is not approval.
remaining_verification: Annual corporate annex03-4/TNDN and its current replacement status
Legal entitlement and caps separately for every partner treaty
ocr_policy: OCR used only to locate pages. Findings checked against original scan; no unreviewed OCR admitted as authoritative text.
